name: Allmersbach im Tal (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically red and white, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Allmersbach im Tal (a red crossbow on white).
history: Arms and the red-white flag were granted by the Minister of the Interior of Baden-Württemberg on 16 September 1965.

features.role: Allmersbach im Tal arms — red crossbow on white
